title: E0703 targets ERbeta to facilitate the upregulation of GLI3, thereby alleviating irradiation-induced DNA damage on lymphocytes.
authors: Liao, Zebin; Zhang, Liangliang; Wu, Zekun; Hu, Changkun; Tang, Xianglin; Xiao, Chengrong; Qian, Liren; Gao, Yue
one_liner_zh: 该文研究E0703通过ERbeta上调GLI3缓解辐射诱导的淋巴细胞DNA损伤，虽涉及ERbeta-DNA结合（ChIP）和分子对接，但核心是辐射防护机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法以湿实验为主，AI/物理模拟仅辅助，匹配度低。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Radiotherapy for malignant tumor treatment and irradiation (IR)-related diagnosis damage lymphocytes, which inevitably suppresses immunity and leads to unwanted clinical outcomes. However, a few agents have been approved by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to alleviate IR-induced injury. Here, the radioprotective effect and underlying mechanism of a new steroidal compound optimized from estradiol (E0703) were investigated. METHODS: Mice were exposed to gamma-ray IR to establish an in vivo model of radiation injury, and human peripheral blood B lymphocytes (AHH-1) were employed to investigate injury in lymphocytes. Protein level changes in cell and tissue samples were detected by western blot and immunofluorescence. DNA damage was assessed by the comet assay and gammaH2AX staining. RNA sequencing was used to screen the critical genes mediating the radioprotective effect of E0703. To determine the direct target of E0703, cellular thermal shift (CETSA), drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS), molecular docking, and surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assays were adopted. GLI3 transactivation by estrogen receptor beta (ERbeta) was determined by the chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) assay, while protein interactions were detected by coimmunoprecipitation (Co-IP). IP products were subjected to label-free proteomics assay to screen GLI3 conjugates. RESULTS: E0703 significantly improved survival and tissue injury in mice exposed to IR damage. In lymphocytes, IR-induced DNA damage was ameliorated with E0703 in an ataxia-telangiectasia mutated protein (ATM)-checkpoint kinase 2 (CHK2)-dependent manner. ERbeta but not ERalpha was a direct target of E0703, wherein ERbeta enhancement on the promoter region of GLI3 triggered by E0703 could sustain its protein expression. The interaction between GLI3 and eIF4G1 favored by E0703 was critical for the formation of the eIF4F translation-initiation complex. eIF4F assembly was indispensable for the stimulation of ATM-CHK2 signaling involved in DNA damage repair. CONCLUSIONS: E0703 alleviated IR-induced DNA damage in lymphocytes by selectively targeting ERbeta. The formation of the eIF4F complex in a GLI3-dependent manner was critical for ATM-CHK2 activation triggered by E0703. Our study provides an alternative countermeasure to alleviate IR-induced lymphopenia in individuals undergoing radiotherapy or IR-related diagnosis.
abstract_zh: 背景：恶性肿瘤放射治疗及放射（IR）相关诊断造成的损伤会破坏淋巴细胞，不可避免地抑制免疫并导致不良临床结局。然而，目前仅有少数药物获美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准用于缓解IR引起的损伤。本研究探讨了一种从雌二醇优化而来的新型甾体化合物（E0703）的辐射防护作用及其潜在机制。方法：小鼠暴露于γ射线IR以建立辐射损伤体内模型，并采用人外周血B淋巴细胞（AHH-1）研究淋巴细胞损伤。通过蛋白质印迹和免疫荧光检测细胞和组织样本中的蛋白水平变化。采用彗星实验和γH2AX染色评估DNA损伤。利用RNA测序筛选介导E0703辐射防护作用的关键基因。为确定E0703的直接靶点，采用细胞热位移分析（CETSA）、药物亲和响应靶标稳定性（DARTS）、分子对接和表面等离子体共振（SPR）实验。通过染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）实验测定雌激素受体β（ERbeta）对GLI3的反式激活，而蛋白相互作用通过免疫共沉淀（Co-IP）检测。IP产物进行无标记蛋白质组学分析以筛选GLI3结合物。结果：E0703显著改善了暴露于IR损伤小鼠的存活率和组织损伤。在淋巴细胞中，E0703以共济失调-毛细血管扩张突变蛋白（ATM）-检查点激酶2（CHK2）依赖的方式改善了IR诱导的DNA损伤。ERbeta而非ERalpha是E0703的直接靶点，其中E0703触发的ERbeta对GLI3启动子区域的增强作用可维持其蛋白表达。E0703促进的GLI3与eIF4G1之间的相互作用对eIF4F翻译起始复合物的形成至关重要。eIF4F组装对于参与DNA损伤修复的ATM-CHK2信号通路的刺激不可或缺。结论：E0703通过选择性靶向ERbeta减轻了IR诱导的淋巴细胞DNA损伤。以GLI3依赖方式形成的eIF4F复合物对E0703触发的ATM-CHK2激活至关重要。本研究为接受放疗或IR相关诊断的个体缓解IR诱导的淋巴细胞减少提供了一种替代对策。
